label: GOD_4 is INFINITE_1: whatever is GOD_4 satisfies the primitive INFINITE_1 predicate
paraphrase: God is infinite (ST I q.7 a.1): whatever is God satisfies the primitive Infinite predicate (DEF-INFINITE). In CATHOLICISM-STAGE2-GOD-IS-INFINITE it is derived from God's act of being being its essence, not received in anything.
